question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of electricity transmission and distribution lines in Germany, with voltage level, operator and status?

answer.summary: ATKIS provides open vectors for high-voltage overhead lines. BNetzA’s project layers cover transmission expansion sections with voltage, operator and status. JAO’s Core static grid model gives circuit voltage and operator without geometry. OpenStreetMap adds some distribution routes and cables, with variable completeness. VDE FNN serves generalised 380 and 220 kV routes. No complete open distribution dataset was verified.
main_caveats: The ATKIS sources checked focus on overhead lines, with a documented capture threshold of 110 kV. Voltage, operator and status were unavailable in the samples. These sources do not provide a distribution cable inventory.
BNetzA layers cover only BBPlG/EnLAG expansion sections; 46 of 157 BBPlG features are 'Luftlinie' or 'Korridorverlauf', not routes.
VDE FNN geometry is generalised (about one vertex per 4.4 km), has no operator field and states no licence.
JAO/TSO static grid models list circuits by substation pair with TSO and kV but no geometry; the bundled HTML map draws straight lines.
TenneT's WMS returns images only; its 2018 terms require written permission to store, digitise or republish the data.
answer.confidence_reason: All listed sources opened and queried (national OSM, DLM250, three Länder, JAO, BNetzA); DSO publication only sampled (WEMAG NAP, Bayernwerk blocked) and GDI-DE catalogue unreachable.

attributes.note: Official vectors: ATKIS overhead lines ≥110 kV and BNetzA expansion sections; OSM adds cables and MV/LV lines; TenneT WMS is image-only.
attributes.gap_note: No official open routes of underground cables or MV/LV lines: checked BNetzA, BKG/Länder ATKIS, VNBdigital NAPs, four TSO sites, TenneT/Bayernwerk WMS, GovData (Düsseldorf points to Planauskunft).

attributes.note: With geometry: BNetzA projects, VDE 380/220 kV and OSM (98% of line ways). JAO gives kV per TSO circuit without geometry; ATKIS has none.
attributes.gap_note: No official voltage on 110 kV or MV/LV routes: ATKIS SPG empty in NRW (-9998), absent in HE, BY and DLM250; no other official layer found.

attributes.note: BNetzA Vorhabenträger (projects), JAO TSO per circuit (no geometry), TenneT WMS owner by click, OSM operator on 59% of line ways.
attributes.gap_note: No open per-line operator for the 110 kV and MV/LV networks; ATKIS and VDE lack the field; DSO plans only via Leitungsauskunft portals after registration.

attributes.note: BNetzA per-section lifecycle (in Betrieb … vor/im Planfeststellungsverfahren); VDE operating vs planning/construction; OSM construction tags.
attributes.gap_note: No official lifecycle field for the existing grid (ATKIS maps existing lines only); DSO planned measures only in NAP spreadsheets without geometry and UVP-Verbund notices.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap power=line / power=cable / power=minor_line (via Overpass API)
sources.format: Overpass API JSON/XML (ways with node geometry); OSM extracts (PBF)
sources.summary: OSM via Overpass: 51,354 power=line ways in Germany, 98% with voltage, 59% with operator, plus cables and minor lines.
sources.coverage_note: All voltage levels; volunteer completeness, cables underrepresented.
caveats: Operator missing on 41% of line ways.

problems: overpass-api.de returns HTTP 406 to requests without browser headers; other public instance used.

sources.summary: ATKIS AX_Leitung provides open routes for high-voltage overhead lines. The BKG DLM250 extract contains 12,986 records. The Länder also publish Basis-DLM layers.

members_summary.scope_note: 16 Länder Basis-DLM (Baden-Württemberg, Bayern, Berlin, Brandenburg, Bremen, Hamburg, Hessen, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Niedersachsen, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Rheinland-Pfalz, Saarland, Sachsen, Sachsen-Anhalt, Schleswig-Holstein, Thüringen) plus two BKG national products; 3 Länder and DLM250 tested.
members_summary.pattern: Land surveying open-data portal → 'ATKIS Basis-DLM' WFS or download → feature type AX_Leitung / layer sie03_l OBJART 51005.

if_unstructured.summary: Routes of planned or approved 110 kV–525 kV lines and DSO plans appear in approval documents (Lagepläne 1:2000, Masttabellen) and §14d network plans; these give operator, voltage and status.

local_terms.meaning: Overhead line; ATKIS bauwerksfunktion 1110 and BNetzA 'Ausführung'.
TSO per-circuit grid table, now collected on JAO for the Core region.
DSO expansion plan (§ 14d EnWG) with Netzkarten, published on VNBdigital.
Approval decision; annexes include Masttabellen and Lagepläne of the route.
Project sponsor (the TSO/DSO) in BNetzA and UVP records.
220/380 kV transmission / 110 kV distribution voltage levels.
Utility location enquiry for works; operator plans after registration.

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
